setup.title: Set up
setup.subtitle: Create the administrator account. The password is stored on your server and nowhere else.
setup.glossHint: Russian dictionary data is markedly thinner than English. If you choose Russian, missing senses fall back to English and are labelled as a fallback rather than substituted silently.
setup.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Length matters more than special characters.

today.title: Today

loopHints.memory: Spaced review. In the morning, before email.
loopHints.input: Comprehensible audio or text. Commuting, exercising, cooking.
loopHints.study: Grammar on odd days, sentence mining on even ones.
loopHints.human: A live teacher or tandem partner. Twice a week.

today.humanNotice: The app cannot tick this off for you. A real person is the one irreplaceable part: a model has no social stakes, understands your broken Hungarian far too well, and will tell you nothing about your pauses or intonation.

empty.title: Ready to start
empty.body: The language pack is not installed yet, so the loops are empty. This is Phase 1 — the skeleton runs; the content comes next.

review.desiredRetentionHint: The share of cards you should recall. Below 0.80 material decays before it consolidates; above 0.95 workload grows faster than the benefit.
review.newPerDayHint: The most common reason people abandon spaced repetition is a review avalanche three weeks in. The workload forecast arrives with the review engine.
review.goalHint: Your goal reweights the card directions: you get back what you train.

drill.title: Grammar drills
drill.gateHint: Topics are drilled in blocks until accuracy reaches this threshold, and only then interleaved. Interleaving too early prevents the rule from consolidating — this contradicts the common advice, deliberately.

services.hint: All of these are optional. The core app works completely without them.

errors.network-unreachable: The server is unreachable. Check that it is running.
errors.notFoundBody: There is no such page here.

review.allDoneBody: The queue is empty. Come back tomorrow — spacing only works if you keep to it.
review.newCapped: {n} more new cards are waiting: the daily limit is reached. That is a guard, not a fault — it is what stops the review avalanche three weeks from now.

diff.vowelLength: Vowel length. It distinguishes words in Hungarian: the form is “{expected}”. This is an ear problem before it is a writing problem — worth training perception.
diff.vowelQuality: Vowel rounding. The form is “{expected}”. The front rounded vowels (ö, ő, ü, ű) have no English counterpart, so ear training is what helps here.
diff.harmony: Right case, wrong variant of the suffix: it should be “{expected}”. This is vowel harmony — a motor skill rather than knowledge, so it needs volume.
diff.feature: Wrong grammatical feature. The form is “{expected}”.
diff.stem: Different word. It should have been “{expected}”.

reader.thresholdCaveat: The 95% and 98% lines were derived for English and are indicative only. “By element” is the stricter figure: a word counts only if both its lemma and every grammatical feature on it are known — you can know “ház” and still be stopped by “házaimban”.
reader.pickAWord: Pick a word in the text.
reader.keys: j / k — move by word · K — known · i — ignore · a — add card

certainty.uncertain: This form has several readings; the more frequent one was chosen. Check it against the sense.
certainty.derived: Derived automatically rather than attested — it may be wrong.

library.title: Title
library.titleHint: optional — we'll take the opening words
library.textHint: Paste an article, subtitles or a chat log — something you actually wanted to read.
library.empty: Nothing here yet. Paste something you genuinely want to read — difficulty is handled by selecting sentences, not by simplifying the text.
